notes:
E-Sys MAX 5.1.0

- The window title bar now turns properly dark with the dark theme.
- Service reset: reads every module that keeps service data on F and G cars,
  and reads the engine oil service more reliably (retry and per-item handling).
- Service reader: smoother reading and clearer results.
- FDL editor: your ready-made pick now stays selected while names and sheets
  finish loading.
- Setting names that are not yet confirmed are shown in red so they stand out.
- About screen: the contact form is now its own tile next to "Talk to us".

Thanks for using E-Sys MAX.
